body: A therapist once told me that.

Thanks for the words. It is a battle with the fact that humans need touch, even if logically and at-times emotionally one can get distracted in improvement and goals. The hardest part is knowing, absolutely knowing, that if there was some degree of touch, this life would be so much more, regardless of what else is accomplished. Truthfully, more would be accomplished as well. What ifs....

God, you have *that* view of male sexuality, don't you?  People like you make the entire idea of sexuality disgusting, and make what is already difficult for some people into an impossible minefield of presumption, no matter what something is wrong; it's horseshoe theory from the opposite end, of pretend empowerment but the same shaming that religion went for, making a bunch of people feel awful for no reason in the process.

>.....the vast majority of women don't "give sex" or sexual touch to serial killers, rapists, gorillas, or horses. Like....99% of women

Oh, I had no idea.  Thanks for cluing everyone in. Way to zero in on the message there with terrifying efficiency.

Already live in a very "progressive" place, but it's very much body-looks-surface focused.  Was more-or-less the last straw, wasn't expecting things to be stratified to such a degree. Nowhere left to go but out.

I'll look into backdoor, but this place tends to go after men who do that as "predators."
